create_JanusImageProcessor: create a JanusImageProcessor instance with custom size, mean, and background color settings
resize_image_square: resize a torch tensor image to a specified square size while preserving aspect ratio and minimum size
pad_to_square: pad a batch of torch tensor images to square dimensions using a configurable background color
preprocess_images_batch: preprocess a batch of images by grouping, resizing, padding, rescaling, and normalizing into pixel values
postprocess_pixel_values: postprocess normalized pixel values back to original image format with optional PIL image conversion
